text.title: Single Page Case Study Generation — Procedure
text.summary: Eight steps from a delivered engagement to a published one-page case study: confirm a defensible number inside the 30-day window, export and store the evidence, get the publication version and the verbatim quote in writing, draft the six slots within 7 days, write the outcome-first title, fit the page to 500 words and one chart, add one tracked CTA, then publish or park within 14 days, validate and schedule the 90-day review.

step.name: confirm-a-defensible-number-inside-the-window
step.input: The engagement's delivery date; the systems the outcome can be read from (Stripe, server logs, GA4, calendar, P&L, ticket tracker).
step.action: Record `dates.delivery_date`. Confirm at least one outcome with a baseline and a final value readable from an exportable system, and that today is within 30 days of delivery.
step.decision-gate: No measurable outcome: skip per 06-decision-tree.xml and log the engagement in one line; more than 30 days since delivery: log as missed, do not write retroactively (r-seven-day-draft-fourteen-day-publish).

step.name: export-and-store-the-evidence
step.action: Export each number's baseline and final value with its measurement window; store the exports privately and list them in `inputs_used[]` with `name` and `path`. Fill `slots.numbers[]` with `metric`, `baseline`, `final`, `unit`, `delta_pct`, `window`, `source_system` and the `evidence_ref` naming the stored file.
step.decision-gate: A number whose export cannot be produced is removed from the study (r-evidence-source-named-and-kept, r-numbers-baseline-final-delta).

step.name: get-the-version-and-the-quote-in-writing
step.input: The client contact; the NDA or contract confidentiality clause.
step.action: Ask for the named version; if declined, offer the anonymised version (industry, size band, context, quoted role). Capture one verbatim sentence from the contact by email or message together with permission to publish; store it and list it in `inputs_used[]`. Set `publication_version`, `slots.pull_quote` and, when anonymised, `anonymisation` with `client_consent_ref` and `identifiers_removed: true`.
step.decision-gate: Only a written refusal of both versions moves the engagement to `internal_log_only`; paraphrased praise or a verbal permission is not a quote (r-nda-fallback-never-drop, r-pull-quote-verbatim-with-written-permission).

step.name: draft-the-six-slots-within-seven-days
step.action: Within 7 days of delivery write `slots.problem` (1 to 2 sentences), `slots.approach` (2 to 3 sentences naming `stack_or_method`), `slots.outcome` (1 sentence with the headline number) and set `slots.nda_indicator`; record `dates.draft_date`.
step.decision-gate: A missing slot or a slot outside its sentence range is a rejected draft (r-six-slots-on-one-page).

step.name: write-the-outcome-first-title
step.input: The headline number and the engagement's time frame.
step.action: Write `title` leading with the outcome, containing the number and the time frame ("How a Series-B fintech cut checkout latency 62 percent in 3 weeks"); the client name appears only in the named version.
step.decision-gate: A title that leads with the service or the freelancer is rejected (r-outcome-first-headline).

step.name: fit-one-page
step.input: The drafted slots and any chart or screenshot.
step.action: Count the words of the whole document into `word_count` (at most 500) and the charts or screenshots into `media_count` (at most 1); cut until both hold.
step.decision-gate: A second page is a rejected draft (r-six-slots-on-one-page).

step.name: add-one-tracked-cta
step.input: The discovery-call booking page; the tracking convention (UTM or tracked link).
step.action: End the study with exactly one CTA to the booking page and record `cta` with `count: 1`, `target: discovery_call` and the tracked `url`.
step.decision-gate: No CTA or several competing CTAs: not published (r-single-cta-tracked-to-discovery-call).

step.name: publish-or-park-validate-and-schedule-the-review
step.input: The finished page; the site, proposal pack or LinkedIn pin it goes to.
step.action: Within 14 days of delivery publish, or park with `park_reason` and `revisit_date`; record `dates.publish_or_park_date` and `status`. Set `outcome_review.due_date` 90 days after publication with `findings: null`; at the review fill `discovery_calls_attributed` and `included_in_closed_proposal`. Run `scripts/validate-single-page-case-study-generation.py --file` on the report.
step.output: Validated report; the review in the calendar.
step.decision-gate: Past 14 days with neither a publication nor a parked reason and date: the deadline rule is broken (r-seven-day-draft-fourteen-day-publish).

list.item: Report validates via `scripts/validate-single-page-case-study-generation.py` with no violation, including the date windows, delta arithmetic, sentence counts and evidence references.
The evidence exports and the permission message are stored at the paths in `inputs_used` for as long as the study is published.
The 90-day review is in the calendar with the CTA's tracking parameter ready to be read.
